nonClaim: A PASS for one case does not imply whole-gateway semantic equivalence.

cases.name: basic-chat
cases.obligation: Non-streaming user/assistant message semantics survive the bridge without hidden prompt mutation.

cases.name: streaming-text
cases.obligation: Text chunk order is preserved and terminal completion is explicit and complete.

cases.name: tool-call
cases.obligation: Tool name, call identity and arguments are preserved exactly enough for Harness tool dispatch.

cases.name: streaming-tool-call
cases.obligation: Fragmented tool-call deltas reconstruct one stable call identity/name/arguments.

cases.name: tool-result-continuation
cases.obligation: A tool result can be returned and the next model turn continues the same logical interaction without identity loss.

cases.name: reasoning-continuity
cases.obligation: Required reasoning/thinking carriers or provider signatures survive any continuation that requires replay.

cases.name: responses-continuation
cases.obligation: Responses continuation identity such as previous response/item references is preserved where protocol semantics require it.

cases.name: structured-output
cases.obligation: Structured-output / JSON-Schema constraints are not silently weakened or rewritten.

cases.name: multimodal
cases.obligation: Image/attachment/tool-result carriers preserve type, order and references.

cases.name: cancellation
cases.obligation: Downstream cancellation reaches the active upstream attempt and is classified distinctly from provider failure.

cases.name: timeout-classification
cases.obligation: Timeout origin and attempt standing are observable; timeout is not silently recast as a semantic model failure.

cases.name: retry-before-commit
cases.obligation: Retry before any externally committed response/effect is bounded and recorded.

cases.name: ambiguous-effect-retry
cases.obligation: No automatic redispatch occurs after ambiguous or possibly committed external effect without reconciliation.

cases.name: healthy-affinity
cases.obligation: A session/turn affinity remains stable while the selected account/route is eligible.

cases.name: same-provider-failover
cases.obligation: If a bound account becomes ineligible, compatible same-provider/model candidates can be considered without silently changing provider/model identity.

cases.name: quota-classification
cases.obligation: Transient rate limit and exhausted quota/capacity are classified separately enough for bounded recovery.

cases.name: effective-upstream-identity
cases.obligation: Effective provider/model and non-secret account/connection identity are observable for the committed attempt.

cases.name: catalog-capability
cases.obligation: Model capabilities come from structured provider/gateway evidence; do not infer them from model names.

cases.name: credential-nonleakage
cases.obligation: Secrets do not enter Harness messages, logs, receipts, Host Work or model-visible context.

cases.name: network-authority
cases.obligation: The expected Network-v2 egress is bound/observable and required VPN routes cannot silently direct-fallback.
